Descriptions.ShortDescription: Automatically uploads captured astrophotography images to Astrovault cloud storage
Descriptions.LongDescription:
Astrovault automatically uploads your captured astrophotography images to secure cloud storage.

Features:
- Automatic upload when images are saved
- Persistent queue that survives restarts
- Retry logic with exponential backoff
- Non-blocking uploads (doesn't slow down imaging)
- Storage-quota aware: stops cleanly when your plan is full, shows a persistent notice with a one-click resume, and never loses a frame
- Storage usage display in the plugin options

Configure your API endpoint and key in the plugin options.
